target.title: fix(gateway): defer hot-reload restart when dist/entry.js is missing
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Pushing commits into a live production git checkout triggers the gateway's hot-reload while `dist/` is mid-rebuild. The watcher (`requestRestart()` in `scripts/watch-node.mjs`) immediately sends SIGTERM to the current healthy child process without checking whether the replacement build has produced a valid `dist/entry.js`. The new child cannot start → exits with SIGTERM → the exit handler sees SIGTERM as restart-worthy → spawns another child → crash-loop until systemd's start-limit is exhausted (37-min outage, P1, issue #99603).

## Changes

Two guard points in `scripts/watch-node.mjs`:

1. **`requestRestart()`** — before sending SIGTERM, verify `dist/entry.js` exists via the new exported function `isDistEntryMissing(cwd, existsSync)`. If missing, skip the kill and log. The running process is already loaded in memory and continues serving traffic.

2. **Exit handler** — when a child exits with SIGTERM/143 (either from guard 1 or from an external signal), check `dist/entry.js` before restarting. If missing, settle the watcher so systemd restarts the process tree cleanly rather than crash-looping.

## Evidence

**Unit tests (21/21 passed):**
\`\`\`
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  21 passed (21)
\`\`\`

**Real behavior proof:**
\`\`\`
HOT-RELOAD RACE GUARD PROOF
Hostname: LIN-66D8BD4EA2C
PID:      788361
Timestamp: 2026-07-03 17:46:32

  ✅ isDistEntryMissing returns true when entry.js does not exist
  ✅ isDistEntryMissing returns false when entry.js exists
  ✅ Real FS temp dir: create/remove dist/entry.js → correct behavior
  ✅ requestRestart() has guard: isDistEntryMissing check before SIGTERM
  ✅ Exit handler has guard: isDistEntryMissing check before restart
  ✅ All 21 watch-node tests pass (including 5 new guard tests)
  ✅ All 88 run-node + watch-node tests pass (no regression)

Broader checks:
  Lint:            0 warnings, 0 errors
  Type check:      passed
\`\`\`

## Review

- Manually reviewed and verified
- AI-assisted: Yes
